title: House-Breaker
summary: HOUSE-BREAK'ER, noun house'-breaker. One who breaks, opens and enters a house by day with a felonious intent, or one who breaks or opens a house, and steals therefrom, by daylight.

inlines.v: HOUSE-BREAK'ER, noun house'-breaker. One who breaks, opens and enters a house by day with a felonious intent, or one who breaks or opens a house, and steals therefrom, by daylight.
